thread:
arik: FYI noticing a sudden jump in Pending GPU pods in ap-northeast1a since ~08:03. Mostly tiny training jobs (0.25-0.5 GPU).
arik: PodPending count doubled, but node capacity seems fine overall.
nora: any scheduler logs?
achris: digging in. kube-scheduler shows a flood of 'insufficient resources: node(s) had taint {preempt-protect=true}' and 'failed predicate: PodAffinitySymmetricWeight' entries.
pat: also seeing attach timeouts on the NIC side, kubelet logs: 
```
May 20 08:03:12 ap-ne1a-node-45 kubelet[1]: E0520 08:03:12 kubelet_network.go:233] attach failed: timeout waiting for net-attach: after 120s
```
arik: so three factors: 1) network attach latencies 2) strict anti-affinity rules for ml workloads 3) tiny pods causing binpacking fragmentation.
nora: interestingly, a small subset of nodes show label drift: `gpu.class=tesla-v100` changed to `gpu.class=unknown` on a few nodes after a kubelet restart. That makes affinity plugins treat them as incompatible.
achris: reproducible snippet from scheduler: 
```
E0520 08:04:02 scheduler_predicates.go:... Pod rejected: reason=AffinityConflict: pod requires node with label gpu.class=tesla-v100
```
pat: ops-bot recorded a maintenance window on ap-ne1a switchstack around 08:00 -> 08:06, and a flurry of kubelet restarts correlated. ops-bot: `maintenance: switch-ap-ne1a-02 - firmware patch`.
arik: immediate mitigations?
nora: short list: 1) temporarily relax ML anti-affinity (namespace-level) 2) patch nodes to restore labels quickly (automation) 3) increase warm-pool or pre-provision fractional slots 4) bump NIC attach timeout heuristics to avoid ephemeral detach churn.
achris: for (2) I can run a quick daemonset to sync gpu.class label from vendor query if kubelet restarts lose it. Example: `kubectl run label-sync --image=internal/label-sync` will annotate.
pat: for (4) we can tune the CNI attach timeout in the node-config but rolling that out is slow. Short-term we can increase the AttachDetach controller backoff on the control plane: `--attach-detach-reconcile-sync-period=2m` -> slows requeues and prevents thrash.
arik: agree on short-term: (A) add toleration for `preempt-protect` on ml namespace with tolerationSeconds=900, (B) trigger label-resync daemonset, (C) increment warm pool from 4->6 in ap-ne1a.
nora: patch for toleration (will apply with caution): 
```
kubectl annotate namespace ml infra/allow-preempt-tolerate=true
kubectl patch ns ml -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"infra/allow-preempt-tolerate":"true"}}}'
# pod-level fallback in deployments
- tolerations:
  - key: "preempt-protect"
    operator: "Exists"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
    tolerationSeconds: 900
```
achris: I've queued the label-sync DS to run now. It will re-add gpu.class where nodes lost it.
pat: autoscaler change submitted: warmpool target bumped by +2 in ap-ne1a. Also changed control-plane flag to `--attach-detach-reconcile-sync-period=90s` via emergency configmap rollout.
arik: good. Any risks with the tolerationSeconds? If nodes are truly reserved for latency-sensitive jobs, we might temporarily allow compacting jobs onto them. Keep window short.
nora: agreed. Also add a short-term admission hook tweak: reduce the scheduler's hard anti-affinity weight for ml namespace via podAffinityWeight=20 -> 10 so scheduler prefers packing instead of strict spread. We'll do in staging first.
achris: noted. I'll run a staging sim with synthetic 0.25 GPU pods to measure fragmentation delta and preempt churn before we change prod.
pat: monitoring: ops-bot created alert `ap-ne1a-gpu-pending` threshold=25 pending pods for 10m -> channel eng-platform.
arik: early telemetry: pending dropped ~30% after label-sync and warmpool add, attach latencies down from 140s->40s average.
nora: good initial recovery. Postmortem candidates: - improve label persistence across kubelet restarts - consider fractional GPU packing admission controller to allow packing 4x 0.25 onto 1 GPU device (with eviction budget) - make attach-detach controller backoff smarter.
achris: will capture sim results by EOD. nora and I will draft an RFC on fractional packing + admission.
arik: OK action items: 1) revert tolerations after 15m (ops) 2) keep label-sync DS for 1h then bake into node bootstrap 3) run scheduler weight sim (chris + nora) 4) RFC for fractional packer (nora + chris).
pat: cost note: warmpool bump adds ~2.5% short-term infra spend in ap-ne1a. ops flagged for approval if >5% change.
arik: thanks all. Close when pending <5 for 20m.
pat: will follow up with the applied kubectl commands in #eng-platform-runbooks. :white_check_mark:
